steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Earth has four main layers: crust, mantle, outer core and inner core | Key Fact: The crust is thin (5-70 km) and made of solid rock; continental crust is granitic, oceanic crust is basaltic | Key Fact: The mantle is the thickest layer (~2,900 km); the upper mantle is solid but the asthenosphere is partially molten and can flow slowly | Key Fact: The outer core is liquid iron and nickel; it generates Earth's magnetic field through convection currents

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from earth&#x27;s structure &amp; composition, and one past-paper question.
